postprocess-ghosts-l.dxbc, postprocess-ghosts-m.dxbc and postprocess-ghosts-m2.dxbc:
the shipped UniFinal.psh fp_ghostsL (ps_5_0, 6,940 bytes), fp_ghostsM (7,256
bytes) and fp_ghostsM2 (7,084 bytes) pixel shaders, extracted read-only from
GRID 2's shaderpack/dx11/postprocess.pssg (SHA-256
b14e2b958cce18dc67d8316312661abe54933839e343c8bf8b0e24293c4bd7af) at byte
offsets 192438, 199753 and 75415. Their renderer fingerprints (FNV-1a 64 of the
bytecode, as passed to CreatePixelShader) are b6247b71227a095f,
1b484999d8a78af0 and 280cc622b338b43b.

These are GRID 2's lens flare ghosts. Each samples the bright image at screen
coordinates scaled and mirrored by lensFlareParams ($Globals 208..271), subtracts
a threshold (row 320) and adds the result tinted by lensFlareParams2 rows 0-2
($Globals 272..319). fp_ghostsM also adds its previous result (t1); fp_ghostsM2
also merges the medium and large bloom (t1, t2 by $Globals 1000/1004) and its own
input by lensFlareParams3 ($Globals 336). The test renders each shader on WARP
and requires the patched draw to match the shader's own output with the tint rows
at zero byte for byte.
